description: Minified gzip budget in bytes for each JS entry point in package.json exports: the entry file plus every chunk it statically imports, each minified with esbuild before it is gzipped. Checked by tools/check-bundle-size.mjs; each budget is the measured size plus headroomPercent, and at least minimumHeadroomBytes. lazyChunks are the chunks loaded by a dynamic import(): each `source` built on its own, minified, its own dynamic imports inlined, and the packages in `external` left out because the main entry already carries them in full (the element imports the @babylonjs/core barrel).
